title: Recordings and his own compositions
summary: His band never recorded, though King Oliver did; he names three pieces he copyrighted.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Mr. Dewey, did you and your group ever make any recordings of any kind?
No, not mine. King Oliver did, but I had to have with, I had to stop playing at that time.
Let it go. Mr. Dewey, have you ever written any pieces of music?
Yes, I wrote three and I still got them right here. They've been copyrighted and everything. The Evangeline Blues, I like to take my girls to the beach, and Lafayette Stomp.
